criteria.statement: Runtime control interface exposes execution-mode metadata and remains a narrow execution seam.
Docker and Podman desired-state apply report execution_mode=engine_api and route runtime mutations through the Engine API control client.
Compose desired-state apply reports execution_mode=cli and routes Compose up through a CLI-backed executor.
Compose compatibility mode is explicit in config; factory construction rejects Compose targets without execution_mode=cli.
Normative deployment docs describe execution_mode values and Compose compatibility requirements.
